title: docs: reprioritize roadmaps for v1.0 UI essentials and spec compliance
body:
Roadmap priorities were ordered around DX/UX polish (P1-P5, all completed) while pending UI-critical work for v1.0 — spec-compliant view configs, navigation properties, core CRUD features — sat at P2/P3 with no release gating.

Reorganized all four roadmap documents to put v1.0 ship-blocking UI work first.

### ROADMAP.md
- **New P0:** v1.0 UI Essentials — ActionEngine pipeline, metadata API migration, view navigation compliance (Gallery navigation, `navigation.width`/`navigation.view`), spec-compliant configs (TimelineConfig, GalleryConfig), ListView spec properties (emptyState, hiddenFields, quickFilters)
- **New P1:** UI-facing spec compliance — DensityMode, exportOptions, Gantt inline editing, map clustering
- **P2-P5:** Completed foundation (DX, UX, Components, Docs) preserved as reference
- Added v1.0 Release Criteria metrics table

### ROADMAP_SPEC.md
- Elevated items #64-68, #71-72 (Timeline/Gallery types, navigation properties, emptyState) from P1/P2 → **P0**
- ListView spec props split: emptyState P0, quickFilters/hiddenFields P1, inlineEdit/virtualScroll/conditionalFormatting P2
- Completed items moved to dedicated reference section
- New compliance breakdown: View Config 85%→98%, Navigation 86%→100% after P0

### ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md
- Phase 10 split into **10a** (v1.0: export, file upload, related lookup) and **10b** (post-v1.0: import, dashboard DnD, notifications)
- ActionEngine + metadata API migration flagged as v1.0 blockers
- GA target Q3 → Q2 2026

### ROADMAP_DESIGNER.md
- Phase 2 scoped to **ViewDesigner + DataModelDesigner** only (v1.0 essential)
- New Phase 2b for PageDesigner/ProcessDesigner/ReportDesigner (post-v1.0)
- `FieldTypeName` type + field type selector elevated to P0
